# Bundled runtime dependencies

Unmodified distributions, pinned to the versions below. Import-only libraries are loaded on demand. The original WebAssembly binaries remain next to `planner.html` and can be replaced independently.

| Package | Version | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| three.js and examples | 0.128.0 | https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128 |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/tree/v3.10.1 |
| rhino3dm | 8.17.0 | https://github.com/mcneel/rhino3dm |
| occt-import-js | 0.0.23 | https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js |
| web-ifc | 0.0.66 | https://github.com/ThatOpen/engine_web-ifc |
| dxf-parser | 1.1.2 | https://github.com/gdsestimating/dxf-parser |

Corresponding license and notice files are included here. fflate is included as the three.js r128 example dependency and retains its license header. Open CASCADE's separate terms are included in `occt-LICENSE.txt`.
